actual: During the authorized P2-4 request preparation, psycopg2 OperationalError from _resolve_outcome_tail_end escaped the source-preflight boundary. The durable receipt incorrectly recorded failure_reason_code=hmm_risk_p2_4_unknown_execution_failure and failure_stage=unknown instead of a typed source-preflight failure, although holdout_accessed/product_acceptance/model/READY/DB/runtime remained false. Fix must preserve fail-closed behavior, one-logical-holdout boundary, exact failure evidence, and must not retry or read holdout.
